answer: Each agent identity is registered in the harbor consensus contract from a zero-knowledge TPM/SGX enclave attestation, with wander as the VDF-sequenced enrollment state tree and lantern as its hash anchor. Forging identities requires physically extracting enclave keys or solving each VDF before its delay expires, while quadratic bonding O(N^2) and irreversible collateral slashing make Sybil expansion superlinear; valid attestations remain linked to measured code.
